description: Live bug bounty on Cantina (not a time-boxed competition). Tenbin is an asset tokenization protocol: off-chain futures hedging plus on-chain collateral management keep tokenized real-world assets (gold, BRL, MXN) pegged. Rewards: Critical $40,000, High $15,000, Medium $5,000, Low $1,000. A reproducible proof of concept is mandatory. Only NEW bugs pay: the codebase has been audited by Spearbit, Zellic, Fuzzland and Verilog (reports in audit/), and dozens of findings were already submitted to the program, so common patterns are very likely known. Prefer deep, protocol-specific logic bugs (peg/collateral accounting, oracle handling, staking/revenue math, module permissions, upgrade paths) over generic patterns.
knownIssues: Anything requiring a privileged role (owner, admin, custodian, controller operator) to act maliciously is a trust assumption, not a finding. Do not test against deployed contracts on public chains (all PoCs run locally in Foundry). Findings already listed in the audit reports under audit/ are known. Gas, informational and best-practice notes are not accepted.
